answer: Coordination lease with decay requires every identity to prepay a nonrefundable lease, renewed by verified work, before group action; fake accounts keep paying as real work builds a garden. The registry rejects actions whose leases trace to one funder, like a lagoon with no outlet, and charges each alias a renewal fee plus lost lease on expiry. As joined leases rise, renewal cost climbs with the tide, so N aliases pay N base fees plus repeated expiries.
